summary: Glossary entries for roles and rolling updates controlled by the serial keyword.
questions: How do I update servers a few at a time instead of all at once?
What does the serial keyword do?

answer_card.title: Glossary: roles, rolling updates, serial
answer_card.answer_md:
- **Roles**: reusable units of tasks, variables and handlers with a standard file structure, shareable across playbooks.
- **Rolling update**: update N nodes at a time to avoid outages. Use the `serial:` keyword on a play to set the batch size. By default all hosts are addressed at once, so you must opt in.
